senses.en: honest, innocent, and direct; lacking cunning

example.en: Her ingenuous smile made everyone trust her immediately.
example.zh: 她天真的笑容让大家立刻信任了她。

senses.en: a condition of passing frequent watery stools

example.en: Drinking contaminated water can cause diarrhoea.
example.zh: 饮用受污染的水可能导致腹泻。

senses.en: to leave someone sad by taking away a close person, especially through death

example.en: The accident bereaved her of her only son.
example.zh: 那场事故使她痛失独子。

senses.en: a diver equipped for working or swimming underwater

example.en: A frogman inspected the ship's hull underwater.
example.zh: 一名蛙人下水检查了船体。

senses.en: used to introduce someone or something that is part of a larger group

example.en: The price includes breakfast, including coffee.
example.zh: 价格含早餐，包括咖啡。

senses.en: a small horse

example.en: The children rode a pony at the fair.
example.zh: 孩子们在集市上骑小马。

senses.en: proof that something is true or exists

example.en: Her success is a testament to years of hard work.
example.zh: 她的成功是多年辛勤工作的证明。

senses.en: a person's will, a legal document stating how property is distributed after death

example.en: He signed his last testament before the surgery.
example.zh: 他在手术前签署了最后的遗嘱。

senses.en: either of the two main divisions of the Bible

example.en: The Old Testament contains many ancient stories.
example.zh: 《旧约》包含许多古老的故事。

senses.en: morally wrong; violating accepted principles of right and wrong

example.en: Lying to your friends is immoral.
example.zh: 对朋友撒谎是不道德的。

senses.en: a clergy member who serves a school, hospital, prison, military unit, or similar institution
senses.zh: （学校、医院、军队等的）专职牧师；教士

example.en: The army chaplain led the memorial service.
example.zh: 军队牧师主持了追悼仪式。

senses.en: busy or already involved in an activity; (of a phone line) in use
senses.zh: 忙碌的；（电话线）占线的；使用中的

example.en: The line is engaged—please try again later.
example.zh: 电话占线，请稍后再拨。

senses.en: having agreed to marry

example.en: They got engaged last spring.
example.zh: 他们去年春天订婚了。

senses.en: feeling a need to drink

example.en: After the long walk, everyone was thirsty.
example.zh: 长途步行后，大家都口渴了。

senses.en: eagerly desiring something

example.en: Young players are thirsty for success.
example.zh: 年轻选手渴望成功。

senses.en: dry; needing moisture

example.en: The thirsty soil cracked under the summer sun.
example.zh: 干渴的土地在夏日阳光下开裂。

senses.en: the sport of competing in races of speed, e.g. with horses or cars

example.en: He has been interested in motor racing since childhood.
example.zh: 他从小就对赛车运动感兴趣。

senses.en: one of the tendons at the back of the knee

example.en: He pulled a hamstring while running.
example.zh: 他跑步时拉伤了腘绳肌。

senses.en: to severely limit the effectiveness of something

example.en: The new regulations may hamstring small businesses.
example.zh: 新规定可能会严重削弱小企业。

senses.en: one of the parts into which something is divided

example.en: Cut the orange into segments.
example.zh: 把橙子切成瓣。

senses.en: to divide something into parts

example.en: The company segmented the market by age.
example.zh: 公司按年龄划分市场。

senses.en: a type of entertainment that aims to make people laugh, especially a play or film with a happy ending
senses.zh: 喜剧；引人发笑的一种娱乐形式，尤指结局圆满的戏剧或电影

example.en: We watched a romantic comedy last night.
example.zh: 我们昨晚看了一部浪漫喜剧。

senses.en: a funny incident or series of amusing events
senses.zh: 滑稽事件；一连串引人发笑的误会

example.en: The mix-up at the office was a comedy of errors.
example.zh: 办公室里的混乱是一场令人啼笑皆非的连环误会。

senses.en: a thin piece cut from a larger amount of food or other material

example.en: She added a slice of lemon to her tea.
example.zh: 她往茶里加了一片柠檬。

senses.en: a share or portion of something such as money, profit, or time

example.en: The company gave employees a slice of the profits.
example.zh: 公司把一部分利润分给了员工。

senses.en: to cut something into thin pieces

example.en: He sliced the cucumber for the salad.
example.zh: 他把黄瓜切片做沙拉。

senses.en: having happened or begun a short time before now

example.en: Her recent trip to Japan inspired several new paintings.
example.zh: 她最近的日本之行激发了几幅新画的创作。

senses.en: a hard, usually shiny material such as iron, gold, or aluminum that conducts heat and electricity

example.en: The bridge is built from steel and other metals.
example.zh: 这座桥由钢和其他金属建造。

senses.en: a style of loud rock music with heavy electric guitars

example.en: They formed a metal band in high school.
example.zh: 他们高中时组建了一支重金属乐队。

senses.en: made of metal

example.en: He stirred the soup with a metal spoon.
example.zh: 他用金属勺搅拌汤。

senses.en: not special, unusual, or different; normal

example.en: It was just an ordinary day at school.
example.zh: 那只是学校里普通的一天。

senses.en: the usual or normal situation, especially in the phrase "out of the ordinary"
senses.zh: 平常的事；常规（常用于 out of the ordinary）

example.en: Nothing out of the ordinary happened on the trip.
example.zh: 旅途中没有发生什么不寻常的事。

senses.en: sudden and unexpected

example.en: The meeting came to an abrupt end.
example.zh: 会议突然结束了。

senses.en: speaking or behaving suddenly without politeness

example.en: His abrupt reply surprised everyone.
example.zh: 他生硬的回答让大家都吃了一惊。

senses.en: changing sharply, with steep slopes or transitions

example.en: The path ends at an abrupt drop.
example.zh: 小路在陡然的落差处中断了。

senses.en: a teacher who gives private lessons to one student or a small group

example.en: She hired a math tutor to help her son improve his grades.
example.zh: 她请了一位数学家教来帮助儿子提高成绩。

senses.en: a university teacher who guides individual students (British usage)
senses.zh: 导师；（英国大学）指导教师

example.en: Talk to your tutor if you have questions about the course.
example.zh: 如果你对课程有疑问，可以找你的导师谈。

senses.en: to teach a single student or small group privately

example.en: He tutors students in English on weekends.
example.zh: 他周末给学生辅导英语。

senses.en: to make a person or part of the body unable to move or feel

example.en: The accident paralysed him from the waist down.
example.zh: 这次事故使他腰部以下瘫痪。

collocations: be paralysed from the waist down

senses.en: to make a system, organization or activity unable to function

example.en: The strike paralysed the city's transport system.
example.zh: 罢工使该市的交通系统陷入瘫痪。

senses.en: metric unit of volume equal to 1,000 cubic centimeters
senses.zh: 升（公制容积单位，等于1,000立方厘米）

example.en: The bottle held exactly two liters of water.
example.zh: 瓶子里的水正好是两升。

senses.en: the duty to explain your actions and accept responsibility for them

example.en: Government officials should have clear accountability for how public money is spent.
example.zh: 政府官员应对公共资金的使用承担明确的问责责任。

senses.en: a common male given name

example.en: Paul is my older brother's name.
example.zh: 保罗是我哥哥的名字。

senses.en: Saint Paul, the apostle and missionary who wrote several New Testament epistles
senses.zh: 保罗（《圣经·新约》中的使徒、传教士）

example.en: The Epistles of Paul are an important part of the New Testament.
example.zh: 保罗书信是新约的重要组成部分。

senses.en: to prepare food by heating it

example.en: She cooks dinner for her family every evening.
example.zh: 她每天晚上为家人做晚饭。

senses.en: a person who prepares food

example.en: My uncle is a cook at a small restaurant.
example.zh: 我叔叔是一家小餐馆的厨师。

senses.en: an official rule or suggestion about how something should be done

example.en: The hospital follows strict guidelines to keep patients safe.
example.zh: 这家医院遵循严格的准则来保障患者安全。

senses.en: guidelines (plural): written instructions on how to do a task

example.en: Read the guidelines carefully before you fill out the form.
example.zh: 填写表格前请仔细阅读指南。

senses.en: the industry or process of making goods in large quantities, especially in factories

example.en: Manufacturing accounts for a large share of the country's economy.
example.zh: 制造业在该国经济中占很大比重。

senses.en: relating to the making of goods in factories

example.en: The company opened a new manufacturing facility last year.
example.zh: 该公司去年开设了一家新的制造工厂。

senses.en: mocking and scornful in a bitter, humorous way

example.en: She gave a sardonic smile at the absurd excuse.
example.zh: 听到这个荒唐的借口，她冷冷一笑。

senses.en: to burn a dead body to ashes

example.en: Her remains were cremated according to her wishes.
example.zh: 根据她的遗愿，她的遗体被火化了。

senses.en: to give reasons or excuses to justify something

example.en: He rationalized his spending by saying he deserved a treat.
example.zh: 他为自己花钱找理由，说自己理应犒劳一下。

senses.en: to make a system or process more efficient

example.en: The company rationalized its operations to cut costs.
example.zh: 公司精简了运营以削减成本。

senses.en: to pass urine from the body

example.en: The doctor asked how often the patient needed to urinate.
example.zh: 医生询问病人排尿的频率。

senses.en: the marks used in writing to separate sentences and clarify meaning, or the use of these marks

example.en: Correct punctuation makes the sentence easier to understand.
example.zh: 正确使用标点使这个句子更容易理解。

senses.en: something you aim to achieve

example.en: Her goal is to finish the course this year.
example.zh: 她的目标是今年完成这门课程。

senses.en: a point scored in games such as football

example.en: He scored the winning goal in the last minute.
example.zh: 他在最后一分钟打进了制胜球。

senses.en: the frame or net where players try to send the ball

example.en: The ball hit the post and bounced away from the goal.
example.zh: 球击中门柱后弹离球门。

senses.en: belonging to or connected with the person speaking
senses.zh: 我的；属于或与说话人有关的

example.en: My brother lives in Shanghai.
example.zh: 我哥哥住在上海。

senses.en: the act or process of moving through the air

example.en: The bird's flight lasted only a few seconds.
example.zh: 那只鸟的飞行只持续了几秒钟。

senses.en: a journey made by airplane

example.en: Our flight to Beijing leaves at noon.
example.zh: 我们飞往北京的航班中午起飞。

senses.en: a set of stairs between one floor and another

example.en: She climbed a flight of stairs to the office.
example.zh: 她爬了一段楼梯到办公室。

senses.en: the act of running away or escaping

example.en: The thief was caught after a brief flight.
example.zh: 小偷逃跑不久后就被抓住了。

senses.en: a folded cover or holder for keeping papers together

example.en: She put the contract in a blue folder.
example.zh: 她把合同放进了一个蓝色文件夹里。

senses.en: a place on a computer for storing files and other folders

example.en: Move the photos into a new folder.
example.zh: 把照片移到一个新文件夹里。

senses.en: covered with or full of mud

example.en: Take off your muddy boots before you walk on the carpet.
example.zh: 在地毯上走之前，先把沾满泥的靴子脱掉。

senses.en: not clear; confused or vague

example.en: His explanation of the plan was rather muddy.
example.zh: 他对这个计划的解释相当含糊。

senses.en: to make something dirty with mud, or make an issue less clear
senses.zh: 使沾上泥；使模糊，使混乱

example.en: Don't muddy the issue by bringing up unrelated complaints.
example.zh: 别提不相关的抱怨把问题搅浑。

senses.en: a person who attacks and robs ships at sea

example.en: The pirate ship sailed into the bay at night.
example.zh: 海盗船在夜里驶进了海湾。

senses.en: to illegally copy and sell copyrighted material

example.en: They pirated thousands of movies and sold them online.
example.zh: 他们盗版了数千部电影并在网上出售。

senses.en: a person who illegally copies and sells copyrighted works

example.en: Software pirates were fined heavily by the court.
example.zh: 盗版软件者被法院处以重罚。

senses.en: matching or related to something else, especially in position, amount, or purpose

example.en: Sales rose this year, and profits showed a corresponding increase.
example.zh: 今年销售额上升，利润也相应增长。

senses.en: a small unit of money in the UK, worth 1/100 of a pound; also a coin of this value
senses.zh: 便士（英国货币单位，1/100英镑）；便士硬币

example.en: I found a penny on the sidewalk.
example.zh: 我在人行道上发现了一枚便士。

senses.en: a very small amount of money

example.en: The repair didn't cost me a penny.
example.zh: 这次维修没花我一分钱。

senses.en: to receive money, property, or a title from someone who has died

example.en: She inherited a large house from her grandmother.
example.zh: 她从祖母那里继承了一栋大房子。

senses.en: to receive genetic characteristics or traits from parents

example.en: He inherited his blue eyes from his father.
example.zh: 他的蓝眼睛遗传自父亲。

senses.en: to take over a situation, problem, or position from a predecessor
senses.zh: 接任；接手（职位、问题、局面等）

example.en: The new manager inherited a team with many problems.
example.zh: 新经理接手了一支存在诸多问题的团队。

senses.en: the grey powder left after something burns

example.en: The campfire had cooled to a pile of ash.
example.zh: 篝火已经冷却成一堆灰烬。

senses.en: a deciduous tree with pale wood, or its timber

example.en: The old ash in the garden turns golden every autumn.
example.zh: 花园里的老白蜡树每年秋天都会变成金黄色。

senses.en: something added to complete or improve a thing, such as a pill or added part

example.en: She takes a vitamin supplement every day.
example.zh: 她每天服用维生素补充剂。

senses.en: an extra section added to a book, magazine or newspaper

example.en: The newspaper published a special supplement on the Olympics.
example.zh: 报纸出版了一期奥运会特刊。

senses.en: to add something to make up for what is lacking

example.en: He supplements his income by teaching at night.
example.zh: 他通过晚上教书来补充收入。

senses.en: an official document that proves a fact, qualification, or completion of something

example.en: She received a certificate after completing the training course.
example.zh: 她完成培训课程后获得了一张证书。

senses.en: to officially certify someone or something with a document

example.en: Teachers who pass the exam are certificated by the institution.
example.zh: 通过考试的教师由该机构颁发证书。

senses.en: a fault or imperfection in something

example.en: The report found a serious flaw in the design.
example.zh: 报告发现设计中存在一个严重缺陷。

senses.en: a weakness in someone's character

example.en: Jealousy is his main character flaw.
example.zh: 嫉妒是他性格上的主要缺点。

senses.en: to make something imperfect or weak

example.en: A single typo flawed the otherwise excellent essay.
example.zh: 一个拼写错误损害了这篇原本出色的文章。

senses.en: a person who directs an orchestra or choir

example.en: The conductor raised his baton and the orchestra began to play.
example.zh: 指挥举起指挥棒，乐队开始演奏。

senses.en: a person who collects tickets on a train or bus

example.en: The train conductor checked our tickets at the door.
example.zh: 列车乘务员在门口查看了我们的车票。

senses.en: a material that allows electricity or heat to pass through it

example.en: Copper is a good conductor of electricity.
example.zh: 铜是电的良导体。

senses.en: an artist who makes sculptures

example.en: The sculptor carved a figure from a block of marble.
example.zh: 这位雕刻家用一块大理石雕出一个人像。

senses.en: the outer edge or boundary of an area or thing

example.en: Several small villages stand on the periphery of the city.
example.zh: 城市外围坐落着几个小村庄。

senses.en: a long speech by one person, especially one that prevents others from speaking
senses.zh: 滔滔不绝的长篇讲话；（对他人的）独占式谈话

example.en: He launched into a twenty-minute monologue about his travels.
example.zh: 他滔滔不绝地讲了二十分钟自己的旅行经历。

senses.en: a speech performed by a single character in a play or film

example.en: The play opens with a famous monologue by the main character.
example.zh: 这部剧以主角的一段著名独白开场。

senses.en: a small pale insect that lives in groups and eats wood

example.en: Termites damaged the wooden beams of the house.
example.zh: 白蚁损坏了房子的木梁。

senses.en: in a calm and peaceful manner

example.en: She smiled serenely despite the chaos around her.
example.zh: 尽管周围一片混乱，她依然安详地微笑。

senses.en: a mythical bird that burns itself and is reborn from its ashes

example.en: The legend says the phoenix rises from its own ashes.
example.zh: 传说凤凰从自己的灰烬中重生。

senses.en: a person or thing that recovers or is reborn after destruction or failure

example.en: After bankruptcy, the company became a phoenix in the industry.
example.zh: 破产后，这家公司成了行业中的凤凰。

senses.en: a person who paddles a canoe or kayak

example.en: Experienced paddlers can handle the rapids safely.
example.zh: 经验丰富的划桨者能安全地通过急流。

senses.en: a small plug put into the ear to block noise or water

example.en: She wears earplugs to sleep through the city noise.
example.zh: 她戴着耳塞，即使在城市的噪音中也能入睡。

senses.en: a decrease in the value of something, especially a currency or asset

example.en: The depreciation of the currency made imports more expensive.
example.zh: 货币贬值使进口商品更加昂贵。

senses.en: a reduction in the recorded value of an asset over time, allowed as a business expense

example.en: The company claims depreciation on its delivery trucks each year.
example.zh: 公司每年对送货卡车计提折旧。

senses.en: to express strong formal disapproval of someone's behavior

example.en: The committee censured the senator for his conduct.
example.zh: 委员会因该参议员的行为而对他进行了谴责。

senses.en: strong criticism or formal disapproval

example.en: The motion passed without censure of any member.
example.zh: 该决议在没有对任何成员进行谴责的情况下获得通过。

senses.en: completely clean, without any dirt or marks

example.en: The kitchen was spotless after her cleaning.
example.zh: 她打扫后厨房一尘不染。
